about: The needs-you grammar (research-desk FILE-CONTRACT §5) as cases. needs_you.py's tests and research-desk's Go parser (api/internal/home) both run every case, so the file check and the desk read the same grammar. A decision (an item with Recommended:) carries Packet: naming its brief, work/<ID>/BRIEF.md. options is null when the item has no Options: line (the defaults apply); each problem is text both parsers' messages contain.

cases.name: explicit options with an offered recommendation
cases.text:
## Needs you

### AV4 — Pick one
Two plain sentences.
Recommended: keep — Keep it.
Options: keep — Keep; wait — Wait.
Packet: /abs/work/AV4/BRIEF.md

cases.text:
## Needs you
### AV5 — Pick
Recommended: accept — Accept it.
Packet: /abs/work/AV5/BRIEF.md
### AV6 — Notice only
No recommendation.
